deviations_from_card: Write set shrank: desk/src/lib/desk/pick.ts is unchanged. It gets the guarantee from text() with no edit, and case 5 goes green without one. Case 4 builds judgeSchema as a literal in the test because check.ts does not export it (the card allows only helper imports in Linga files). Case 8 (GUARD) is covered by the full npm test and also by an explicit export-patching test in the new suite. check.ts and conversation.ts keep local required/line one-liners that bind their own error messages, built on the shared fit() from shape.ts; object/str/schema are imported from there. The lessons.ts citation follows critic_revise (DATA at :16, writes at :30/:38).
notes: NEW EXPORTS. engines/types.ts: class EngineError extends Error {kind: 'shape'|'timeout'|'exit'|'unreachable'; provider: string; path?: string} (name 'EngineError'; path is the first failing field such as 'reply', 'topics[0].title' or 'lesson', and '' for the whole answer), plus types Provider<Req,R> {name; run(req): Promise<{raw, provider?, audit?}>}, ProviderAnswer, Providers, EngineKind ('text'|'vision'|'embed'|'speak'|'listen'), ListenRequest, Heard. engines/registry.ts: useProvider(kind, impl), resetProviders(kind?), activeProvider(kind) (returns a name and starts nothing), provider(kind), register(kind, providers, choose). engines/shape.ts: validate(value, schema) -> [path, why][], conform(raw, schema, provider), stripFence, answer(provider, req), and helpers object, str(max, min=1), schema(props) (closed object with every property required), fit(value, max, fail). Named providers: text.ts claudeCli ('claude-cli'), codex.ts codexCli ('codex'), vision.ts ollamaVision, embed.ts ollamaEmbed, voice.ts piper and elevenlabs, listen.ts 'gravitone' and 'elevenlabs'. SIGNATURES UNCHANGED: text(), vision(), embed(), speak(), listen(), codexText() and the EngineResult fields. BEHAVIOUR: text() and vision() now reject with EngineError kind 'shape' when an answer is not JSON or breaks the schema (type, enum, required, additionalProperties:false, min/maxLength, min/maxItems, items), for every provider, isolated Claude calls included. embed() rejects 'shape' unless it gets one number vector per text. CLI and HTTP failures are EngineErrors with the same messages as before, but String(e) now starts 'EngineError:' where it used to start 'Error:'. STUBBING. Stub at the registry and every engine keeps its schema check: reg.useProvider('text', {name:'stub', run: async (req) => ({raw: '{"hint":"x"}'})}), where raw may be a string (fence-stripped and parsed) or an already parsed object. For embed, raw is number[][] with one vector per text. For speak it is a Buffer; for listen it is {text, language?}. Call resetProviders() in afterEach. The old CJS export patching (engine.text = ..., eye.vision = ...) still works because text and vision are still `export async function` in their own modules, and it skips the schema check. Linga, maths and essay suites pass unchanged. RETRIEVAL: lessons.ts reads <DESK_DATA_DIR>/lessons/*.vtt and writes <DESK_DATA_DIR>/embeddings.json, falling back to cwd/data as store.ts does. A worktree dev server with a seeded DESK_DATA_DIR needs lessons/ copied into it for lesson picks. RISK TO WATCH: on Claude, an isolated Linga turn whose optional moment runs past its maxLength (said/better 180, why 140) now fails the whole turn with Linga's error line. Before, parseMoment dropped the moment and the turn went on. Codex already enforced this through --output-schema. Session card B (engines B / desk-pipelines A) can catch EngineError and switch on e.kind instead of printing String(e).
